title: leptogramma diplazioides
intro: Leptogramma diplazioides, commonly known as the Himalayan Bistort or Pattharchoor, is a plant species in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern native to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Leptogramma diplazioides include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as wounds, ulcers, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
